entries.title: Tipping Beam Scale with Sliding Weights
entries.description: A long beam pivoted on a central fulcrum with colored masses that can slide and attach to either side, causing the beam to tilt, bounce, and occasionally slam into soft stoppers while labels show torque values and a vertical “balance meter” bar updates in real time.

entries.title: Stacking Blocks Tower of Stability
entries.description: A tall tower of semi-transparent boxes on a flat plane where new blocks drop from above and can stick or slip, causing the tower to lean, wobble, and sometimes collapse, with collision sparks, trails of falling debris, and a side graph showing center-of-mass drift.
